description: This is a C# source file for defining an API endpoint in an ASP.NET Core application. Specifically, it provides the implementation for creating a new catalog item via a minimal API endpoint using the `Microsoft.AspNetCore` ecosystem and domain-specific classes like `CatalogItem`, `CreateCatalogItemRequest`, and repositories.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for creating catalog items, handling HTTP POST requests, including validation, duplicate checking, item creation, and response generation.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the route for the API endpoint, mapping POST requests to the specified URL and attaching authorization.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the incoming request to create a new catalog item, including duplicate validation, item creation, updating the picture URI, and returning the response.
